verdict_title: A sharp, modern sportsbook with racing streams and a solid casino
verdict:
Novibet earns its place with a fast in-house platform, deep football markets and the features Irish punters use every week — GAA fixtures, UK and Irish racing with live streams and flexible cash out. The welcome offer has a low 1.70 minimum-odds bar, the EUR cashier is one of the broadest around, and the casino fits neatly alongside.

The caveats: no Best Odds Guaranteed on racing, fewer racing promotions than the legacy books, and a bet builder limited to featured games. If you mostly bet on football with some racing on the side, Novibet is one of the cleanest modern choices in Ireland.
